verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a backend platform like Convex, so the axis applies. The pack shows no interactive, runnable API reference: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the only related items are the static HTTP API docs and the CLI `npx convex run` command. Those are adjacent ways to call functions, not an explorable reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
